verdict.rationale: Turso documents explicit PITR ("restore a database to a specific point in time... recovering from user errors, such as dropping a table by mistake") and branching from any existing database (`turso db create ... --from-db`), directly covering both restore and branch-for-recovery workflows within a retention window. Docs also describe automating branch creation, giving platform engineers a scriptable recovery/testing path. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of the retention window length/configurability, no independent/hands-on report confirming a PITR restore actually worked in production.
